Can a car offer a better business class experience than a plane? The same Delhi to Jaipur route. Two very different ways to do it. Over to Renuka Kirpalani in a Mercedes-Benz V-Class and Jay Patil who is flying business.
Camerapersons: Harshad Panchal, Shreyans Chordia, Roshni Manghani
